purpose: Teach: まったり/でかけ/ご機嫌/困ら/頑固/恨み/不器用/留守番

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 今日は、家でまったりしたい気分だ。
lines.en: Today I feel like staying home and taking it easy.
lines.style: Quiet, settling into thought. Slow warm pace. Voice lands on the word 'home' like it's a comfortable place. Slight exhale of contentment at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。スーパー、私だけでかけてくるわ。
lines.en: Yes. I'll go to the supermarket by myself.
lines.style: Practical and gentle. Quick, decisive agreement. Matter-of-fact without coldness — she's offering this kindly, not begrudgingly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 庭の犬、ご機嫌で尻尾振ってる。
lines.en: The dog in the garden is in good spirits. Tail's wagging.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost fond. Speaks with the lightness of someone noticing a small, genuine pleasure. Very slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫が来ても、困らせないよう、おやつ準備したわ。
lines.en: I've prepared snacks for when the grandchildren visit. Won't be any trouble.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact preparation in her voice — she's already thought this through. Warm and assured without needing praise. Practical generosity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: When I was younger, I was stubborn.
lines.style: Dry, almost rueful. A long look back. Not self-pitying — just naming a fact about who he was. Pause before speaking, like he's choosing the words carefully.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 恨み言、お互い、もう忘れたわよ。
lines.en: The grudges we held — we've both let them go now.
lines.style: Quiet, definitive. No weight in her voice anymore. Peaceful release. She's not explaining or justifying — just stating what's true now.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 感情表現は、若い頃も不器用だった。
lines.en: I was clumsy with feelings even back then.
lines.style: Self-aware and gentle. No harshness toward his younger self. Speaks as someone who has accepted this about himself. Matter-of-fact and forgiving.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お留守番、犬と一緒なら寂しくないわね。
lines.en: Sitting with the dog while you're out — I won't be lonely.
lines.style: Warm and assured. Soft smile underneath. She's reassuring him without him asking. Comfortable silence is implied in her tone.
